name: task-manager
description: Find, manage, and leave durable work reports on Task Manager tasks, projects, and releases.

interface.shortDescription: Manage tasks and durable work reports.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Task Manager with OAuth, find work across accessible projects and releases, inspect complete task context, create or update tasks, and publish human-readable completion or blocker reports as native task comments.
defaultPrompt: Show my current tasks and help me choose what to do next
List tasks for a project or release
Finish work on a task and leave a clear technical completion report
